description: Find a high school or an athlete by name. This is the entry point for every other tool: it returns each school's canonicalUrl (the site path the team tools need) and each athlete's careerCanonicalUrl. Search is exact-ish — prefer the plain school name ("myers park"), because appending qualifiers like "high" or "high school" usually returns nothing. Read-only.

query.description: School or athlete name, e.g. "myers park" or "brody keefe"

name: maxpreps_search
title: Search MaxPreps schools and athletes
